body:
Love opioids/opiates, everything about them from the warm glowing euphoria to the itchyness, sedation anxiolysis, muscle relaxation, etc I have multiple experiences with pharm opioids including tramdol, morphine, oxycodone, methadone, and Suboxone. I extensive experience with Kratom and in the past have tried tiantetipine both the sulfate and sodium versions. And I have to say that tiantipinetipine is closest to tramdol as both give off a stimulting "antidepressant" opioid buzz.
1:57 pm having a very low opioid tolerance having taken 250 mg of tramdol 2 days ago and before that burphenophine 12 mg 6 days prior. I decided to try a high dosage of tia sodium I  just received in order to see the full capacity of the recerational effects that this atypical antidepressant  offers. I weigh out 370 mg of powder and parachute it using rolling papers on a completely empty stomach. 4 gs costed around 31 dollars and having tried there product I'm rhe past I knew the quality was appt on.
2:15 laying down noticing a mild opioid glow but this most likely is placebo
2:41 begining to get that characteristic opioid itch, I am mildly sweating , noticable mild mood lift noticable pupil constriction , mild muscle relaxation, moderate anxiolysis with lack of any stimulating or sedating effect. Personally I prefer the sodium version due to the quick come up shorter but intense peak and the redoing is more consistent. If I want the substance to have legs usually take half my dosage and then 2 hrs later take the other half.
2:50 effects are getting stronger with mild stimulation building up. Itch is not annoying but added to he euphoria. Pupils are not pin points or pin and needles. Psychonaut wiki states the onset is 30-60 minutes and come up is 15-30 mins and peak is 60-90 mins which seems dead on accurate for the sodium version at least.
3:00 redose another 366 mg bringing total dosage to 736mg. Right after parachuting I eat. Medium bowl of rice  and head out for a smoke. Really enjoyed my cig it added to he buzz immensely. Very noticable miosis (constricted pupils). Itching never felt so good before l. Most likely the peak of the first 370 mg dosage.
Effects: Moderate cognitive and physical euphoria l, moderate sedation, mild muscle relaxation, moderate dizziness, noticable motivation/ focus enhancement similar to white vein Kratom low dosage of amphetamines and a over deceleration of thoughts due to the sedation.
3:40 smoke a bowl of indica 25 percent thc cannabis that my friend acquired with his medical from the dispensary. Don't feel too stoned, mostly feel the effects of the tia which remained the same as the peak. Overall very very nice  euphoria both physical and cognitive is strong along with the classical opioid like fects.
3:42 I throughly enjoy this compound and is loving the experience.
3:50 redose is kicking my ass I'm peaceful and tranquil yet not nosing our it's awesome.
4:28 more of the same not much has changed , lying down in complete euphoric bliss , I love this compound it feels excatly like taking a handful of pain pills when used at dosage much greater then 12.5 mg sodium for depression in other countries, not used in USA but instead sold online or I heard it even sold at some gas station along with delta 8 thc, thco and other hemp derived cannbioinds, Kratom, phenibut,etc.
4:49 peak is going stronger still enjoying all the opioids bliss this compound produces.
5:00 smoke another bowl of a different strand of weed I acquired a different friend. Moldy stoned as the peak effects of tiantipine slowly subside.
The peak last not more then 2 hrs for the sodium version  really closer to 60-90 minutes. I will end the report saying this I took extremely high dosages.
